description.value:
Three luminous cores—ember, rime, and tempest—turn within the fuller of this black-steel sword. The blade can channel only one core at a time.

Rotate Core 1 (concentrate) Choose ember, rime, or tempest. The selected core remains active until you Rotate Core again. A Strike with the blade deals 1d6 additional damage of the selected core's type: fire for ember, cold for rime, or electricity for tempest. Changing cores does not end persistent damage already dealt.

Core Technique 2 (magical) Frequency once per 10 minutes; Effect Release the active core's technique.

  • Ember—Cinder Arc: Sweep flame through a 15-foot cone. Creatures in the cone take 6d6 fire damage (DC 28 basic Reflex save). A creature that critically fails also takes 1d6 persistent fire damage.
  • Rime—Still Winter: Make a melee Strike. On a hit, the target takes an additional 2d6 cold damage and must attempt a DC 28 Fortitude save. On a failure it is slowed 1 until the end of its next turn; on a critical failure it is slowed 1 for 1 minute, attempting a new save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect.
  • Tempest—Lightning Passage: Stride twice. During this movement you can move through enemies' spaces, treating them as difficult terrain. At any point during the movement, make one melee Strike. On a hit, it deals an additional 2d6 electricity damage. This movement doesn't trigger reactions from the target of the Strike.

Tri-Core Convergence 2 (evocation, magical) Frequency once per day; Effect The cores align and discharge in a 60-foot line. Creatures in the line take 3d6 fire, 3d6 cold, and 3d6 electricity damage with a DC 28 basic Reflex save. A creature that fails is dazzled until the end of its next turn. Afterward, the blade goes dormant until the end of your next turn and functions as a mundane striking longsword during that time.

Automation note: Foundry applies the +2 potency and striking rune automatically. Add the active core's extra 1d6 damage in the damage dialog; the mode is intentionally kept as a player-facing toggle so all three damage types can never stack.
A black-steel sword with three dull crystals set into its fuller.
